draft.title: Choosing a depreciation method
card: A business picks the depreciation method that best matches how an asset gives its benefit over its life. The choice changes how much expense is recorded each year.
suits an asset used about evenly each year, such as office shelving. It gives the same expense every year.
suits an asset that loses value fastest when it is new, such as a delivery van. It gives a larger expense in the early years and a smaller one later.
To choose, ask when the asset does most of its work or loses most of its value. If the loss is even, use straight-line. If it is greatest early on, use reducing balance.
draft.remember: Match the method to the pattern: even use suits straight-line, and heavy early loss suits reducing balance.

a.q: Which asset is best suited to reducing balance depreciation?
opts: A new van that loses most of its value in its first years
Display shelving used the same way every year
A counter that is used evenly until it is replaced
A filing cabinet that wears out at a steady rate
a.why: A new van loses most of its value early, so a larger expense in the early years matches this. The shelving, counter and cabinet are used evenly, so straight-line suits them better.
a.clue: Which asset loses the most value when it is newest?

b.q: Jas runs a bakery in Ballarat. She buys an oven that will bake the same number of loaves each year until it is replaced. Which method suits it, and why?
opts: Straight-line, because the oven is used evenly each year
Reducing balance, because the oven is used evenly each year
Straight-line, because the oven loses most value when new
Reducing balance, because the oven loses most value when new
b.why: The oven is used evenly, so an equal expense each year matches its use, which is straight-line. Reducing balance would suit an asset that loses value fastest when new, and the oven is not described that way.
b.clue: Look at how the oven is used each year, not at what it costs.

a.best: A new van that loses most of its value in its first years

b.best: Straight-line, because the oven is used evenly each year

problems.detail: The right option is the longest. It is also the only one that says 'new' and echoes the card's phrase 'loses value fastest when new', and the clue repeats that idea. A student could pick it by matching words without understanding the method.

a.q: Which asset is best suited to reducing balance depreciation?
opts: A van whose value drops most in its first two years
A shelf whose value drops by the same amount each year
